title: Declassified Upshot-Knothole report puts Stansel at the Nevada tests

tellings.quote: And a declassified report from Operation Upshot Knol confirms Stansel was on site for the nuclear testing there.

plain: A once-secret report on Operation Upshot-Knothole, a series of nuclear bomb tests in Nevada in 1953, confirms that a man named Arthur Stansel Jr. was on site for the testing. Michels cites the report himself in an episode about whether Henry Kissinger oversaw a program to recover crashed UFOs. He uses it to show that Stansel's presence at those tests is backed by an official record.
